reviews.title: It’s just an app to take your money
reviews.text: And i downloaded it to see if it was any good. I opened it and it gave me 2 choices -                                                              1. Sign in with my Apple ID  or 2. Continue.                          I pressed continue where it gave me 3 options.               1. Free trial     2. £19.99 per year    3. £6.99 per week.         I pressed 1.Free trial  which changed Option 3. To 3 day trial and the £6.99 weekly.                                       The screen went blank. Being suspicious I went to my Apple account and there was NO subscription listed for this app. No way for the app to take money from me. So of course the app will not give me three days free without a guarantee that they would get at least 1 weeks money from me (unless I read the small print saying you had to cancel at least 24 hours before the end of you period).                                                                         I am so tired and fed up with the non transparency and downright dishonesty of some, a lot, of these apps which I have, at my cost, found out. This time NO I have learnt to be untrusting and suspicious  and not lost anything. I have deleted the app and I will look for a more reputable app.                                                     What I dont understand is why? If an app is as good as it’s supposed to be, to actually give a free trial for free wouldn’t be a problem because people would want to keep it and, if not an outrageous price, willingly pay for it
